element.description: Chemical element symbol to display when cycling is disabled

elements.description: Element symbols to cycle through; an empty list includes all elements

cycleElements.description: Automatically cycle through the configured elements

shuffleElements.description: Randomize element order when cycling starts

shellScaling.description: Draw atoms with fewer shells smaller: 0 keeps every atom at full size, 1 makes the orbit radius proportional to the shell count

nucleusScale.description: Nucleus size as a ratio of the atom size

electronSpeed.description: Base electron revolution duration in seconds

mixedOrbitDirections.description: Alternate electron direction between shells for visual depth

rotationDuration.description: Duration of one shell-system rotation in seconds

stepRate.description: Move the electrons in this many steps per second instead of smoothly, so that weak devices redraw the atom less often; 0 moves them smoothly, values between 0 and 10 count as 10

showLabel.description: Show the element name and symbol

showElectronegativity.description: Show electronegativity on the Pauling scale

showPeriodicTable.description: Show a small periodic table with the current element highlighted, as the first item of the module (left of the atom when the items are in a row)

showAbundance.description: Show the abundance in the Earth's crust by mass: in percent from 1000 ppm, in ppm down to 0.001 ppm, below that as traces; elements without a value get no row
